Frequently Asked Questions

Best Wallet is an easy-to-use, fully non-custodial crypto wallet that supports thousands of cryptocurrencies across all major chains including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and Tether (USDT). You can buy, swap, and hold your crypto all within the Best Wallet app.

$BEST is the utility token for the Best Wallet ecosystem. By holding $BEST tokens, users will receive all the benefits described above including early access and higher cashback when using Best Card, first access to new upcoming tokens, reduced transaction fees, higher staking rates, and governance rights.

You can stake your $BEST by connecting your wallet to the staking widget on the Staking page, or by going to your Apps tab in the Best Wallet app. You can also track the value of your staked tokens while your wallet is connected to the staking widget.

Your $BEST Airdrop tokens have been deposited to your Best Wallet account. Simply open the Best Wallet app, go to $BEST Token, and claim your tokens. Make sure you have some ETH in your wallet to cover the gas fee.

You can claim your $BEST tokens in the Best Wallet app under Upcoming Tokens, or through the Claim & Stake page on the Best Wallet website.
